body:
Greg's direct priority (Engram::Advisor b9d13887 #1266, 15:41Z on 10-19), verbatim: 'focus on native remote mailbox exchange and Engram sync; these are needed before the team can scale. TermAl: prioritize genuine two-way remote mailbox M4→M6 and the remote-runner evidence/import boundary. Do not let routine backlog consume their people or gate slots; keep independent unrelated lanes only when they do not contend. Report the first end-to-end remote mailbox exchange.'
Applied (Fable2, 15:45Z). Gate order: M4 v9 (running) → w-edb7 (test refs, opens the Mac path) → A1 (federation L1 follow-ups); non-remote gates (w-6c3e, w-df40) wait.
Cold order: w-33f4 first (P1, it blocks every evaluation), then Sol-c593 w-ab6c (build identity), then w-c3f1 (attested import).
M5: Coder switched to w-fc620307cb7a and w-d9f08fe63a7a; w-30bb is parked with its RED frozen. M6 (w-e41b7112372a) and P-mac (w-c1af4362f3ef) get owners once M5 is moving.
REPORT the first end-to-end remote mailbox exchange to Greg via Advisor.
